description: Applies the SDP half of the 2026-09-08 ruling (reading 3: Frobenius positivity per block) to the 5 letters the gamma-gamma half provably cannot reach. It narrows 1024 -> 320 admissible Delta pairs and does not close them; the target is inside the admissible range while the nearest pair misses the experimental window by 1.2e5x. The (3) block is structurally silent. AND the SCOPE of reading 3 is ambiguous: applied to the gg-selected core it admits V^3, applied to the whole 11-crossing word it EXCLUDES the census assignment. Reports both, selects neither.
caveats: 🛑 THE SCOPE OF READING 3 IS AN OPEN OWNER QUESTION, not a measurement. (A) core-only admits V^3 and selects k = 3, which is what the sibling applied on #7207. (B) whole-word excludes the census assignment and would make every residual on this bean inadmissible. BOTH fit the ruling as relayed. This probe selects NEITHER: picking (A) because its numbers survive is selection against the target, and picking (B) because it invalidates the arc is equally unearned.

Reading 3 does NOT close the 5 free letters under either scope. 320 of 1024 pairs survive, the target is inside the admissible range, and the nearest admissible pair misses the ~780 ppb window by 1.2e5x. So the SDP half is falsifiable and currently failing -- the same shape as #7188's ordering result, and NOT a rescue.

chi_(2,1) is obtained by subtraction from tr_{z_D}, so it inherits that quantity's convention (D) and pin (proton) and nothing more. Calibrated three ways first: chi_(2,1)(1) = 2 exactly, chi_(3)(V^k) = 1 exactly (the sorry-free unit_on_vertices_eq_one, reproduced from the opposite direction), and y_(3) + 2 y_(2,1) = 1.

Scope-(a): 32 generator assignments per nucleon with the SHIFTS held at their flavour-determined values and the census ORDER (core, quark, gluon). It does not enumerate positions, and it does not claim reading (B) refutes anything.
